remarks: An extraordinary opportunity to create a landmark coastal residence in one of Laguna Beach's most coveted neighborhoods. Situated on a rare 5,033-square-foot parcel in Top of the World, Butterfly Residence pairs breathtaking ocean views with Design Review Board-approved plans for an approximately 4,400-square-foot architectural masterpiece. Recognized with a 2026–2027 Americas Property Award for Architecture, Butterfly Residence is the culmination of more than four years of collaboration between internationally recognized developer Hakan Buvan and acclaimed Laguna Beach architect David M.
